label: StablR USDR launch, MFSA EMI license, MiCA-compliant via Hadron
StablR mint-key compromise, unbacked mint, USDR depeg low ~$0.64
note: 2026-05-24: StablR mint/governance key compromise (signer threshold not disclosed by StablR); attacker minted unbacked USDR, initially reported at ~8.35M. USDR fell to ~$0.64, repegged to ~$0.994 by 05-26 after StablR froze mint/redeem and asked exchanges to halt trading.
